question: The 'Saptak Music Festival' in Gujarat is celebrated in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Saptak Annual Festival of Music** is a prestigious **Hindustani classical music** festival held annually in **Ahmedabad**, **Gujarat**.
 
• Established in **1980**, the festival was inaugurated by the legendary sitar maestro **Pandit Ravi Shankar** and founded by **Pandit Nandan Mehta** along with his wife **Manju Mehta**.
 
• It is traditionally organized by the **Saptak School of Music** and spans the first **eleven to thirteen days of January**, making it one of the longest music festivals in the world.
 
• The festival serves as a cultural platform where legendary maestros and emerging artists perform various forms of classical music, including **vocal**, **instrumental**, and **Kathak dance**.
 
• The event is dedicated to the memory of **Pandit Kishan Maharaj**, the renowned **Tabla** maestro of the **Banaras Gharana**, who was a mentor to the founders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ahmedabad (The Venue)**:

 
 
• It is recognized as a **UNESCO World Heritage City** and is a major center for arts and commerce in **Western India**.
 
• The city also hosts the **International Kite Festival** (Uttarayan) every year in **January**.
 
 
 
• **Other Musical Traditions in Gujarat**:
 
 
• **Tana-Riri Festival**: Held in **Vadnagar**, it honors the 16th-century sisters Tana and Riri who excelled in the **Malhar Raga**.
 
• **Modhera Dance Festival**: An annual festival of classical dance performed at the historic **Sun Temple** in **Modhera**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Saptak**:
 
 
• Unlike many commercial events, **Saptak** maintains a purely classical focus, often featuring rare instruments like the **Sarangi** and **Vichitra Veena**.
 
• It has hosted world-renowned artists such as **Ustad Zakir Hussain**, **Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia**, and **Pandit Shivkumar Sharma**.
